subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to make the whole story. Only
stimulus: the corresponding numbers of the sentences need to be written. 1×8= 8 (a) An old bridge was over that canal. (b) Babul lived in a village of Bangladesh. (c) Yet none cared for its repair. (d) There was a canal on his way to school. (e) Babul was in difficulty. (f) It was useful to one and all of the villagers. (g) He was a school-boy. (h) So one day it broke down and caused a good deal of hardship to the villagers.
guide_solution: The parts of the story can appear in the following order: 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 b g d a f c h e
